## Description Selecting an organization changed the session but returned to the picker, which had no menu. Selection now opens Connect by default. The picker uses the compact Connect, Switch Workspace, Members, Audit Log menu; non-admin users see only the first two links. Approved `feaddbde` is **live and verified for both production roles**: [deployment and actual button journeys](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-production/README.md). This PR later inherited SO-02 without changing any app source or test file. ## Review **T2 Need architect** — Architecture: **T0: no architecture fact**. The declared `contract` and `internalInterface` changes require T2 under the [review policy](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/a421afc056ce3e400f2779c75683ea45270b96cb/AGENTS.md#review-tier-and-merge-eligibility). **Architecture facts**: - None. All 51 public declaration snapshots and 17 registry diagrams are unchanged. [`.pr-impact.json`](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/44753a72a7c1cecbf076e1448c26a4ae4b93a9f2/.pr-impact.json) declares the default-return change and optional current-access lookup. Registry prose records that use; owners, selection authority, contracts, containers and deployment relationships remain unchanged. **Merge status: blocked; Draft.** The refreshed staging gate passed 22/29 cases but hit WorkOS's sandbox invitation-email quota. Retry after quota availability is confirmed. Current-head owner/architect approval is also required: the recorded approval covers deployed `feaddbde`. Other selected checks pass; retained metric/habit findings have reviewed reasons. No source correction or deployment migration is requested. ### Architecture comparison Supplementary C4 Level 3 view, control-plane Node server; actual base `a421afc0` → head `44753a72`. ```mermaid %%{init: {"theme": "base", "themeVariables": {"fontFamily": "Arial, sans-serif", "fontSize": "16px", "edgeLabelBackground": "#ffffff", "clusterBkg": "#f8fafc", "clusterBorder": "#64748b"}, "flowchart": {"htmlLabels": true, "nodeSpacing": 35, "rankSpacing": 40, "wrappingWidth": 210}}}%% flowchart TB browser["L2: user portal / browser
Read pages; submit native forms"] subgraph server["L2: control-plane Node server"] web["web · TypeScript
Account routes and page rendering
CHANGED: picker menu and default return"] organizations["organizations · TypeScript
List eligible workspaces;
authorize current selection"] workos["workos · TypeScript / SDK
Authenticate and switch sessions;
read current memberships and grants"] web -->|"Existing: listOrganizations;
POST authorizeSelection"| organizations organizations -->|"Existing: current directory reads"| workos web -->|"ADDED GET picker use:
optional selected-workspace access"| workos web -->|"Auth
switch"| workos end remote["External system: WorkOS
Identity, memberships and roles"] browser -->|"Existing HTTP: GET picker;
POST workspace selection"| web workos -->|"Existing HTTPS / SDK"| remote classDef stable fill:#f8fafc,stroke:#64748b,color:#0f172a classDef changed fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#b45309,color:#0f172a class browser,organizations,workos,remote stable class web changed linkStyle 2 stroke:#15803d,stroke-width:3px,color:#166534 ``` - Bare picker forms return to normalized Connect; explicit safe destinations keep their value. - Only identity-bound, selected-workspace Admin access with product permission shows privileged links. - Denial, mismatch or optional lookup failure preserves the basic picker; cancellation propagates. Provider timeout/retry rules remain. - POST keeps Origin, CSRF, return-path and current-membership checks before one switch. Cookie order and MCP bindings remain. L3 plus these notes answers the changed return contract and recovery; L4 would repeat private branches. Inherited SO-02 delivery and SO-03 tenant work are outside this increment. Full provenance and limits are in Quality review. --- Candidate: [44753a72](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/commit/44753a72a7c1cecbf076e1448c26a4ae4b93a9f2) · [Validation](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/281#issuecomment-6453601476) · [Quality review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/pull/281#issuecomment-6453601866)

Isolated ordinary/type/portal/hosted/container/browser checks and the native image workflow ran at `e36e34c9304444312b52d76cc1c91aa365ccc719`. Final head adds only the immutable base metric record: the [recursive input bridge](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection/review/final-head-input-bridge-v4.json) verifies every other tracked object and mode is identical. Live, final metrics, CRAP, habit and tier checks ran at the final head. Execution pins are preserved rather than relabelled. New/changed tests ran locally before their source commits; those earlier red/green records remain linked below.

**Production is fixed and verified at the separately approved `feaddbde`. This refreshed PR remains Draft: its full staging gate is not green, and current-head human approval is pending.**

| --- | --- |

Native image digest is `sha256:aa29d6206d7a0cbd6c4efabdcf1bce3255e4ed7c6fdb4346db6858fa87651f6e`; compressed size 154,747,373 bytes. This workflow did not deploy production.

Fresh unit plus integration coverage captures 196 files/scripts and 767 processes at source head e36e34c9. Both suites were selected by the source change. The final process verifies compatible reuse after the record-only commit; SO-02's changed build inputs were not covered by reusing old captures. No acceptance or live coverage is claimed. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/ci-checks-final.json) contains no configured checks/statuses.

### Live environment failure

The complete final gate ran serially after shared ports became free and finished at 22:52:30 UTC. Six AUTH-08W cases share the same WorkOS `Sandbox environment email quota reached for invitation emails` HTTP 429 during pending-membership fixture creation, request ID `ad077443-8aa6-41ce-a23b-e73848ec010d`, with no Retry-After. The cached rejected setup caused the downstream failures before their tested behavior ran. The removal journey separately got 503 instead of 303 when sending its rejoin invitation. The same quota is a supported inference for that 503, not a directly logged provider error.

The removal journal confirms preceding refusals, removal, last-admin protection and other-account/workspace preservation, then exact cleanup. It does not claim the complete removal journey passed. No immediate retry, skip, assertion/timeout change or provider setting change was made. Retry one serial full gate only after staging invitation-email quota availability is independently confirmed; no reset time is inferred. [Diagnosis and source trace](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/live-quota-review.md), [full failing log](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/hosted-live.log), and [scoped cleanup journal](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/live-evidence/s25-02-mvr9tf6e-955a5c.jsonl).

### Production and retained history

Before this upstream refresh, exact feaddbde had all selected release gates green, including 29/29 live cases. The owner approved that exact release in chat. Render `dep-dbgidiou01pc73c6h7ag` is live at feaddbde since 22:39:16 UTC. Both existing accounts clicked **Thermus AI (selected)** and reached Connect. User sees only Connect/Switch Workspace in both pages; admin also sees Members/Audit Log, and both links work. Workspace selection persists. Health and portal assets returned 200, and the bounded new-instance warn/error query was empty. [Production observations, screenshots and limits](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-production/README.md). No production membership, role, invitation, credential or setting was changed. Git-backed manual deployment remains in place.

The attempted feadd merge was refused after SO-02 landed; only `.pr-impact.json` conflicted. All app source/tests remain identical. The [approved release report](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/e51083b16b27eef9b8ff99696d15747cdaa585be/workspace-selection-refresh/README.md), [approval](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/d73395697a48cd879756a7d12d2421c8c146515d/workspace-selection-refresh/human-approval.json), and [prior PR report](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/pr-pre-final-refresh.json) preserve history. No PR281 merge has completed.

Earlier BDD red (2/12), focused red (21/42 with 20 failures/1 timeout), permission red (56/57), and their green fixes remain recorded. The prior mobile browser run failed two cases before asynchronous workspace text appeared; exact-label readiness under the unchanged timeout fixed the test, and all 83 passed. Historical staging setup refused a source archive/Node22 and hit an occupied port before Node24 serial runs passed. The first old image run built but failed three runtime cases because Colima could not mount a macOS temporary path; the canonical retry passed 7/7. These are earlier failures, not omitted current runs.

Separate PostgreSQL, Collector and live-search gates are N/A for the picker increment; hosted-live includes its nested removal/SQL journey. No extra standalone `npm run check` was added. Public-surface generation's earlier 33 ignored diagnostics concern two unlisted files; all 51 listed snapshots and full typecheck passed. Picker-specific 200% text/long names remain unproven. No-JS proves native selection and Connect URL, not JS-dependent Connect rendering. Production uses the two existing accounts in one existing workspace; alternate-workspace and viewport cases are local/staging evidence.

## Quality review

SO-02 release tooling and SO-03 tenant composition, verifier and signed context are already in the actual base; this increment changes none of them. No ADR or de-escalation is required.

All informational notes and retained findings are disposed as follows:

- All 51 public declaration snapshots and 17 registry Mermaid blocks are identical. Registry prose records the new caller phase; owner/import boundaries remain accurate.
- Existing route MI 59.4408→54.0304 (drop 5.4104) is retained, including the single canonical high maintainability-regression finding. Picker orchestration, optional lookup and identity/workspace/Admin predicate are focused 11/11/7-line functions with 7/3/7 paths. These guards preserve recovery and bind menu display to current session authority. Removing conditions weakens behavior; moving one-use helpers only to relocate the score adds indirection. Keep required decisions at the route owner.
- Existing page MI 66.8578→65.6762 is retained. The Admin branch belongs with native header/form rendering, escaping and CSP. Its changed renderer has 100% coverage and CRAP 2. The style literal has no callable metric; function MI/CRAP is N/A for it.
- All nine changed/tool-new rows have 100% unit/integration coverage and CRAP≤7, with no required identity, assessment or goal miss and no exception. The tool-classified-new cookie filter callback is textually unchanged and also passes its goal. Base CRAP is head-derived, with 81 unknown estimated shares; three unrelated app functions remain unknown. These are analysis limits, not new numeric escalation rules.
- The native report's browser-driver warning at 10 paths does not cross the canonical >10 threshold. The bounded role/link/style/screenshot driver is cohesive, and test helpers have no production MI goal.
- The inherited unresolved `main.ts`→`style.css` import leaves generated dependency evidence incomplete. Manual source/import/registry review supplements it; no absence-of-cycle claim rests on the graph alone. Full reports preserve global context, the unchanged native community cycle and historical limits.
- All 21 comment and 2 oversized-test-file habit findings have [individual path/line reasons](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection/review/habit-hooks-review-final-v4.md). [Detailed metric dispositions](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection/review/metrics-review-final-v4.md), [complete process](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/metrics/process.md), [machine reports](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/tree/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/metrics), and [manager review](https://github.com/tomer-mayara/Thermus/blob/5fec0d05c3991a41a1ce474b6bebf3c19c0130c7/workspace-selection-release-refresh/manager-review.md) retain all reasons and limits.
